{{See also|Nuvian}} {{Infobox/Character |shop = Yes |quests = [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Mage Faction Questline]] ---- {{Quest|Purchase an Abiphone}} |location = [[Scarleton Bank]] |location_page_description = Sells [[Abiphones]]. |x = -78.5 |y = 108 |z = -787.5 }} '''Udel''' is an [[NPC]] located in {{zone|Scarleton}} that sells [[Abiphones]]. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Udel's Abiphone Keynote == {{Aqua|Udel's Abiphone Keynote}} is an event that happens on the dates of [[w:Apple Inc.|Apple Inc.]] events. During this event, new [[Abiphone]] models are announced and revealed. {| class="wikitable" |+ Udel's Abiphone Keynote !Year !Name !Initial Cost !New Feature |- |rowspan="3" | 2022 |{{Item|Abiphone XIV Orange}} | rowspan="9" | {{c|100m}} |rowspan="3" | {{bc}} |- |{{Item|Abiphone XIV Black}} |- |{{Item|Abiphone XIV Purple}} |- |rowspan="3" | 2023 |{{ID|Abiphone Flip: Dragon}} |rowspan="3" | '''{{Gold|Ringtones}}''' |- |{{ID|Abiphone Flip: Nucleus}} |- |{{ID|Abiphone Flip: Volcano}} |- |rowspan="3" | 2025 |{{ID|Abiphone Flip+: Flower}} |rowspan="3" | '''{{Aqua|Speed Dial}}''' |- |{{ID|Abiphone Flip+: Clockwork}} |- |{{ID|Abiphone Flip+: Lunar}} |} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition ! Make sure you come back later to check my stock! }} |- | rowspan="4" class="ct" | {{Aqua|Udel's Abiphone Keynote}} | class="ct" | Interaction |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Udel&f: &7Shh! &e[NPC] Udel&f: &7I'm in the middle of presenting the new Abiphone! }} |- | class="ct" | [[Abiphone|Abiphone XIV]] Announcement |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eHello fellow customer! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eI am glad you could make it! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eToday, I am unveiling the newest technology in Abiphones. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eWe are proud to present: &e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lABIPHONE XIV &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eOur latest addition to the Abiphone line has space for an extra contact! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAnd with the latest technology, you can add FIVE more music discs! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &7&oIt would be better if they were playable... &e[NPC] &cUdel: &7Ahum. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eOur new model comes in 3 atunning colors! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe &6Abiphone XIV &eis our best model yet. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAnd the price is still only &6100m coins&e! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eOn top of that, if you own an old &5Abiphone XIII&e, you can trade it in! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe future of Abiphones is TODAY! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe Abiphone XIV is now for sale! }} |- | class="ct" | [[Abiphone|Abiphone Flip]] Announcement |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eHello customers! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eI am so glad you could make it to my keynote! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eIn the past 72 years, my minions have worked hard to make a new Abiphone model. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eI've obviously been working hard directing my minions! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eI have made great technological leaps since our last model. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSo without further ado, I am proud to present: &e[NPC] &cUdel: &e... &e[NPC] &cUdel: &7&oHello? &e[NPC] &cUdel: &7&oNo, I'm in the middle of my keynote! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &7&oYes, I'll call you back. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAhem. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSorry about that, I forgot to put my Abiphone on vibrate. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAnyways, I am proud to present: &e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lABIPHONE FLIP &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThis stunning new model has a brand-new speaker system. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAllowing you to choose a ringtone from our built-in selection! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThrough sheer determination, I have also managed to find enough space for 1 extra contact! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eTo satisfy my shareholders, I had to double the price of this new Abiphone. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eTo satisfy my customers, I am giving everyone &a50% off&e on their new Abiphone purchase! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThis way, everyone is happy! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eYou can trade in your old &5Abiphone XIV&e for an even bigger discount! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe future of Abiphones is TODAY! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe &6Abiphone Flip&e is now for sale!}} |- | class="ct" | [[Abiphone|Abiphone Flip+]] Announcement |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eHello customers! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eI am so glad you could make it to my keynote! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eFirst, I would like to apologize for this one being a &e&olittle later ðan usual. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThere is an ongoing lawsuit between myself and a [[Abiphones & Co.|counterfeit Abiphone]], which has been taking up most of my time. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eHowever, I am here, and so are you, so let's begin! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &e... &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAhem. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSince my previous keynote, my minions and I have been even harder at work trying to find something even more innovative than the &6Abiphone Flip&e. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eWe thought and thought and then thought some more before I, and only I, had an &oincredible breakthrough&e. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eWhat if our latest model could save you, like, a second, whenever you wanted to call someone? &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAfter all, less downtime for my clientele means I get more uptime on my all-inclusive holidays! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSo, without further ado, I am proud to present: &e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lABIPHONE FLIP &e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lPLUS! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe most cutting edge technology around today, this new model comes with the &bSpeed Dial &efeature! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThis allows you to call your favorite contact with just a single click! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAlso, in my infinite generosity, I have given this model an &aadditional contact slot&e! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThat's all for this year. &bUdel's Abiphone Services &eappreciate your continued support during the ongoing lawsuit! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSo, without further ado... &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe &6Abiphone Flip+ &eis now for sale! }} |} == Trivia == *'''Udel''' used to sell [[Abiphones]] for {{Green|1.5%}} less than their original prices. *'''Udel''' is {{NPCSprite|Dean}}'s cousin. *According to {{NPCSprite|Karis}}, '''Udel''' created the Abiphone but forgot to patent it. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{history|2022/March 8|[[File:Udel.png|26px]] Added '''Udel'''.}} {{History|2025/Aug 28| Removed {{Green|98.5%}} price multiplier from '''Udel'''.| Revamped the shop, and moved Udel one block from {{Coords|-78.5|107|-788.5}} to {{Coords|-78.5|108|-787.5}}. }} |beta= {{history|0.13|[[File:Udel.png|26px]] Added '''Udel'''.}} {{history|2022/Sep 7|link=none|{{Aqua|Udel's Abiphone Keynote}} event occurs.|Added new [[Abiphone|Abiphones]] to '''Udel''''s shop.}} {{History|0.23.4| Removed {{Green|98.5%}} price multiplier from '''Udel'''.| Revamped the shop, and moved Udel one block from {{Coords|-78.5|107|-788.5}} to {{Coords|-78.5|108|-787.5}}. }} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
